description: Convert between Western years (AD), Japanese eras (Reiwa/Heisei/Showa/Taisho/Meiji including transition dates), Taiwan ROC years (民國), zodiac (干支/生肖), and age.

query.description: Free-text date or year expression, e.g. "令和8年", "平成3年5月1日", "S60", "民國87年", "1989", "1998/05/01"

referenceDate.description: Optional reference date (YYYY-MM-DD) for age calculation; defaults to today.

name: convert_era
